coupling_study.registered_question: Does a direct full-outcome CDF common-quantile coupling reduce paired-cutoff variance while retaining the same finite-operator measurement marginal?
coupling_study.primary_rule: Unchanged stage and saved-state scoring gates; paired cutoff95% pointwise intervals wholly inside±.01 at every cycle. Retain all failures/inconclusive outcomes; no added shots until pass.
coupling_study.variance_rule: Descriptive per-cycle ratio of squared SE for directCDF versus legacy paired cutoff means; no confidence claim or causal physical-bias attribution from this ratio.
coupling_study.marginal_rule: Deterministic exact-resourceCDF and Kraus-update tests precede scientific launch. Exact arithmetic interpolation bound is supplemented by explicitly unproved floating allowance; record all actual inverse residuals and nonpositive-norm failures.
coupling_study.combined_comparison: Same fixed768-trajectory budget in every sampler/condition/cutoff arm; algorithm/CRN coupling is changed, not shots. Comparing this128/state study to the historical512/state run is not an isolated sampler comparison.
coupling_study.interpretation: Reduced paired variance does not establish zero true cutoff bias or complete independent instrument/hardware validation. Both sampler marginals describe the same ideal instrument within numerical budgets; their joint replay mapping differs.
coupling_study.prior_confirmation_registration: Original640/640/2048/640per-state independent-noise registration remains Planned/unrun; this is a separate prospective fixed-budget experiment.
